timeline.summary: T T Lakshman declared no encumbrance on 40,11,505 shares of TTK Prestige Limited during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹729.17 Cr (+12.3% YoY), net profit ₹36.08 Cr (against a loss of ₹42.39 Cr a year earlier).
TTK Prestige reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹729.2 Cr, up 12.3% YoY, with a PAT of ₹36.1 Cr.
TTK Prestige published its FY26 annual report showing consolidated revenue of ₹2,973.57 Cr and PAT of ₹156.67 Cr.
TTK Prestige Limited shared the audio recording link of its earnings call with Ambit Capital on May 22, 2026, discussing Q4 & FY26 audited results.
TTK Prestige Limited’s promoter **T. T. Krishnaichari & Co.** declared no encumbrance on its 82,767,238 shares during FY2025-26 (April 1, 2025).
TTK Prestige held its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 22, 2026, reporting a domestic revenue growth of 14.4% and operating EBITDA of ₹81.7 Cr.
TTK Prestige Limited uploaded the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call held on July 28, 2026, to its website on July 31, 2026.
